Welcome to Inkwell
This works just like a notes app, with a few literary tricks.

Words with a wavy red underline are mispelled. Click one to see suggestions, then click a suggestion to fix it. If a word is actualy right (like your name, or slang), choose “Add to Personal Dictionary” and it will never be flagged again.

Click any other word — try serendipity, luminous or wander — and you’ll get a definition set like a page from an old dictionary. Turn that off with the “Look up on click” switch above.

Switch the card to Norse, Latin, Greek or Argot to swap a word for the tongue of the sagas, of Rome, of Homer or of the old Paris thieves: the warrior raised his sword against the wolf.
